[[image:Caemlynmap.png|right|thumb|200px|Map of Caemlyn]]
The '''Inner City''' of [[Caemlyn]] is the oldest part of the city, and is almost entirely [[Ogier]] built. This is evidenced in its conformity to the natural environment. Rather than forcing the land to conform to the builders desires, it uses the natural landscape as a platform for artistic design. This results in winding roads which flow around the city's hills. In addition to this, the roads are designed in as a series of circles which spiral toward the [[Royal Palace of Andor|Royal Palace]] at the center.
